about_the_game:
Welcome to The Mystical Traveler, a video game where you play as the most wonderful cube in the universe, driven by one single goal: to take control of the universe. To achieve this, you will need to complete various journeys across mysterious planets and unexplored solar systems. You will encounter the remnants of forgotten civilizations...

This 2D platformer with a pixel art style promises an immersive experience. Choose your character to shape your own journey: each one has its own advantages. Be strategic to unlock them all and complete each level more easily.

This game incorporates a unique gravity mechanic, allowing you to defy the laws of physics to avoid certain obstacles such as deadly traps, water expanses, and other dangers. By reversing gravity at will, you can walk on the ceiling, reach inaccessible areas, and discover hidden paths. Mastering this mechanic will be essential to progress through the more complex levels.

I invite you to search for all the easter eggs and pieces of lore scattered across each planet. Explore every nook and cranny to uncover what really happened in this mysterious universe.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, SteamOS
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 or AMD RX 480
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11, SteamOS
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-14400 or AMD Ryzen 5 7600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 350 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible

short_description: In The Mystical Traveler, you play as a cosmic cube in a 2D pixel art platformer. Master gravity, explore planets, unlock characters, and overcome various challenges in a mysterious universe.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian
